sender.fromEmailHint: Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị efu, a ga-eji aha onye ọrụ.
sender.gmailAlias: Gmail na-eziga site na {user} ọ gwụla ma etinyere {from} na akaụntụ Gmail ahụ dị ka adreesị “Send mail as”.

verification.title: Nkwenye ndebanye aha
verification.description: Akaụntụ ọhụrụ na-akwenye adreesị email ha tupu ha enwee ike ịbanye. A naghị egbochi akaụntụ emepụtara tupu ị gbanye nke a.
verification.vendorsHint: Ndị na-ere ahịa ị ga-akwado site ugbu a.
verification.needTest: Buru ụzọ ziga email nnwale gara nke ọma, ka njikọ ndị ahụ ruo ndị mmadụ.
verification.needSave: Buru ụzọ chekwaa mgbanwe sava gị ma ziga nnwale.
verification.failingTitle: Akaụntụ ọhụrụ enweghị ike ịbanye ugbu a
verification.failing: Njikọ ha anaghị abịa, n'ihi na email na-ada. Gbanyụọ nkwenye, dozie sava ma ziga nnwale, wee gbanye ya ọzọ.

gmail.step1: Gbanye 2-Step Verification na akaụntụ Google ị ga-esi na ya ziga.
gmail.step2: Mepụta paswọọdụ ngwa aha ya bụ {storeName}, wee detuo paswọọdụ mkpụrụ akwụkwọ 16 ahụ. Google na-egosi ya naanị otu ugboro.
gmail.step3: Tinye sava na port n'elu, adreesị Gmail gị zuru ezu dị ka aha onye ọrụ, na paswọọdụ ngwa dị ka paswọọdụ.
gmail.step4: Iji ziga dị ka adreesị ọzọ, dị ka info@yourstore.com, buru ụzọ tinye ya na Gmail n'okpuru Settings → Accounts and Import → Send mail as.
gmail.caution: Akaụntụ Gmail nke onwe na-eziga ruo email 500 kwa ụbọchị, Google Workspace ruo 2,000. Ụlọ ahịa nwere ọtụtụ ọda chọrọ ọrụ iziga email.

zoho.step1: Jiri smtppro.zoho.com maka adreesị na domain nke gị, ma ọ bụ smtp.zoho.com maka nke na-ejedebe na @zoho.com.
zoho.step2: Ị na-eji ịbanye ụzọ abụọ? Mepụta paswọọdụ ngwa n'okpuru Security → App Passwords ma jiri ya dị ka paswọọdụ.
zoho.step3: Tinye sava na port 587 n'elu, ya na adreesị Zoho gị zuru ezu dị ka aha onye ọrụ.
zoho.caution: Akaụntụ dị na mpaghara ọzọ na-eji sava mpaghara ahụ, dị ka smtppro.zoho.in ma ọ bụ smtppro.zoho.eu.

hosting.step1: Na cPanel, mepee Email Accounts ma pịa Connect Devices n'akụkụ adreesị ị ga-esi na ya ziga.
hosting.step2: N'okpuru Secure SSL/TLS Settings, detuo Outgoing Server na SMTP Port.
hosting.step3: Tinye ha n'elu, ya na adreesị email zuru ezu dị ka aha onye ọrụ na paswọọdụ igbe ozi ahụ.
hosting.caution: Njehie asambodo na-apụtakarị aha sava dị iche. Jiri nke cPanel gosiri, ọbụna ma ọ dị ka server123.yourhost.com.

brevo.step1: Na Brevo, mepee SMTP & API, wee mepee SMTP tab, ma detuo aha nbanye SMTP gị. Ọ na-ejedebe na @smtp-brevo.com.
brevo.step2: Pịa Generate a new SMTP key ma detuo igodo ahụ. Paswọọdụ Brevo gị anaghị arụ ọrụ ebe a.
brevo.step3: Na Brevo, tinye email onye na-eziga n'ime ndị na-eziga, ma ọ bụ kwado domain gị.
brevo.step4: Tinye sava na port n'elu, aha nbanye SMTP dị ka aha onye ọrụ, na igodo ahụ dị ka paswọọdụ.
brevo.caution: Ị na-eziga site na domain nke gị? Tinye ndekọ SPF na DKIM Brevo nyere gị, ma ọ bụghị ya email gị nwere ike ịbanye na spam.

sendgrid.step1: Na SendGrid, mepee Settings → API Keys ma mepụta igodo nwere ikike Mail Send. SendGrid na-egosi ya naanị otu ugboro.
sendgrid.step2: Kwado email onye na-eziga gị, ma ọ bụ domain gị niile, n'okpuru Settings → Sender Authentication.
sendgrid.step3: Tinye sava na port n'elu. Aha onye ọrụ bụ okwu apikey, paswọọdụ bụkwa igodo ahụ.
sendgrid.caution: SendGrid na-ajụ email site na adreesị onye na-eziga ọ kwadobeghị.

ses.step1: Na console Amazon SES, kwado domain gị ma ọ bụ email onye na-eziga n'okpuru Identities.
ses.step2: Mepee SMTP settings ma detuo SMTP endpoint. Wee pịa Create SMTP credentials ma detuo aha onye ọrụ na paswọọdụ: a na-egosi ha naanị otu ugboro.
ses.step3: Tinye ha n'elu. Igodo nnweta AWS gị anaghị arụ ọrụ ebe a.
ses.caution: Akaụntụ ọhụrụ nwere ike iziga naanị na adreesị akwadoro. Rịọ production access tupu ụlọ ahịa gị emepee nye ọha.

other.step1: Chọọ “SMTP settings” n'enyemaka onye na-eweta ọrụ gị, ma ọ bụ jụọ ha maka sava email maka iziga.
other.step2: Tinye sava n'elu ya na port 587, ma ọ bụ 465. Zere port 25: ọtụtụ netwọk na-egbochi ya.
other.step3: Aha onye ọrụ na-abụkarị adreesị email gị zuru ezu. Ọ bụrụ na onye na-eweta ọrụ gị na-enye paswọọdụ ngwa, jiri otu.
other.caution: Outlook.com na Hotmail kwụsịrị ịnabata paswọọdụ akaụntụ site na ngwa ndị ọzọ na 2024. Microsoft 365 ka na-anabata ya, mana Microsoft ga-agbanyụ nke a na ndabara na njedebe 2026, ya mere ọrụ iziga email bụ nhọrọ kacha nchekwa.

google.label: Ịbanye site na Google
google.description: Ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịbanye na Google
google.step1: Mepee Google Cloud Console wee họrọ ọrụ dị adị, ma ọ bụ mepụta otu maka ụlọ ahịa a.
google.step2: N'okpuru APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen, dejupụta aha ngwa, email nkwado na ngalaba enyere ikike, wee bipụta ngwa ahụ. Ọ bụrụhaala na ọ nọ na Testing, naanị ndị ọrụ nnwale ị depụtara nwere ike ịbanye.
google.step3: Gaa Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID wee họrọ Web application dị ka ụdị ya.
google.step6: Detuo Client ID na Client secret n'ime ubi ndị dị n'elu, chekwaa, wee pịa Nyochaa nzere. Ndị ahịa Google ọhụrụ nwere ike iwe nkeji ole na ole tupu ha amalite ịrụ ọrụ.

facebook.label: Ịbanye site na Facebook
facebook.description: Ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịbanye na Facebook
facebook.step1: Mepee Meta for Developers → My Apps → Create app, wee họrọ ebumnuche “Authenticate and request data from users with Facebook Login”.
facebook.step2: Tinye ngwaahịa Facebook Login na ngwa ahụ, wee mepee Facebook Login → Settings.
facebook.step3: Gbanye Client OAuth login na Web OAuth login, wee tinye nke a n'okpuru Valid OAuth Redirect URIs:
facebook.step4: Na App settings → Basic, tọọ Site URL ka ọ bụrụ
facebook.step4c: n'okpuru App domains. Meta na-achọkwa URL Iwu Nzuzo tupu ngwa ahụ enwee ike ịdị ndụ.
facebook.step5: Detuo App ID na App Secret n'ime ubi ndị dị n'elu, chekwaa, wee pịa Nyochaa nzere.
facebook.step6: Gbanwee ngwa ahụ site na Development gaa na Live. Ruo mgbe ahụ, naanị ndị nwere ọrụ na ngwa ahụ nwere ike iji Facebook banye.

localRetired.title: A kwụsịla nchekwa mpaghara
localRetired.body: Faịlụ ndị dị na sava a ga-anọgide na-adọta, mana nbugo ọhụrụ chọrọ otu n'ime ndị na-eweta ọrụ dị n'okpuru. Họrọ otu, tinye ozi nzere ya, wee mepee “Bufee faịlụ ndị ị nwere ugbua” — iwu ndị ahụ na ndabere a ga-ewere tupu mbugharị ọzọ dị ebe ahụ.

cloudflare_r2.bucket: Na dashboard Cloudflare mepee R2 → Create bucket. Aha ya na-abanye na Aha bucket n'elu.
cloudflare_r2.token: R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens → Create API token, ikike Object Read & Write, naanị maka bucket ahụ. Detuo akụkụ abụọ ahụ n'ime Access Key ID na Secret Access Key n'elu — a na-egosi nzuzo ahụ naanị otu ugboro.
cloudflare_r2.account: Detuo Account ID nwere mkpụrụedemede 32 site na mpịakọta akụkụ nke peeji R2 gaa na R2 Account ID.
cloudflare_r2.public: Bucket → Settings → Public access: gbanye subdomain r2.dev ma ọ bụ jikọọ ngalaba nke gị, wee tinye adreesị ahụ na URL ọha.
cloudflare_r2.test: Pịa Nwalee njikọ, wee chekwaa. Nnwale ahụ na-ebugo otu faịlụ nnwale ma gụọ ya ọzọ site na public URL, ya mere ọ ga-ada ma ọ bụrụ na ị wụfere nzọụkwụ gara aga.
cloudflare_r2.caution: Na-enweghị URL ọha, foto ngwaahịa ọ bụla ga-eweghachi 403 na ihe nchọgharị ọbụna ma ozi nzere dị mma — faịlụ ndị ahụ na-esi na endpoint R2 nzuzo, nke a na-adịghị agụ na-enweghị nyocha. Ngalaba nke gị ka mma karịa r2.dev: CDN Cloudflare na-azaghachi arịrịọ echekwara na-anaghị ana bucket ụgwọ.

s3.bucket: Mepụta bucket na console S3 ma dekọọ mpaghara ya — ọ ga-adaba na mpaghara ahọpụtara n'elu.
s3.iam: IAM → mepụta onye ọrụ nwere ohere mmemme na iwu na-enye ikike ndị a na bucket ahụ:
s3.public: Kwe ka ọha gụọ site na iwu bucket, ma ọ bụ tinye CloudFront n'ihu ya, wee tinye adreesị ahụ na URL ọha.
s3.test: Tinye ụzọ igodo abụọ n'elu, pịa Nwalee njikọ, wee chekwaa.
s3.caution: Bucket ọhụrụ na-abịa na Block all public access agbanyere. Hapụ ya ka ọ dị naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-eji CloudFront — ma ọ bụghị ya, foto ọ bụla n'ụlọ ahịa ga-eweghachi 403.

minio.run: Gbaa MinIO n'akụkụ ngwa ahụ — Coolify na Dokploy nwere ihe nlereanya otu pịa. Tinye volume na /data, ma ọ bụghị ya, mbugharị na-esote ga-ewepụ faịlụ niile ebugoro.
minio.keys: Mepee console MinIO (ọdụ 9001 na ndabara), mepụta bucket, wee Access Keys → Create access key.
minio.public: Kwe ka ihe nchọgharị gụọ bucket ahụ:
minio.fields: Endpoint URL bụ adreesị API (ọdụ 9000), ọ bụghị console. Mpaghara nwere ike ịnọgide na us-east-1 — MinIO na-eleghara ya anya. URL ọha bụ ebe ihe nchọgharị na-eru bucket.
minio.caution: Nye MinIO site na HTTPS na subdomain nke ya. Ihe nchọgharị na-egbochi ọdịnaya agwakọtara, ya mere endpoint http:// na-emebi foto niile n'ụlọ ahịa HTTPS.

digitalocean.space: Spaces Object Storage → Create a Space. Ebe data ị họọrọ bụ endpoint ahụ (nyc3, fra1, sgp1…), ya mere họrọ nke dị nso na ndị ahịa gị ma họrọ otu mpaghara ahụ n'elu.
digitalocean.keys: API → Spaces Keys → Generate New Key, wee detuo akụkụ abụọ ahụ n'ime Access Key ID na Secret Access Key.
digitalocean.public: Space → Settings → mee ka File Listing bụrụ nke ọha, ma ọ bụ gbanye CDN.
digitalocean.test: Hapụ URL ọha ka ọ tọgbọrọ chakoo iji nye site na Space n'onwe ya, ma ọ bụ tinye endpoint CDN (…cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com) iji nye site na nsọtụ. Mgbe ahụ nwalee njikọ ma chekwaa.
digitalocean.caution: Aha Space bụ Aha bucket n'elu, a pụghịkwa ịkwaga Space gaa ebe data ọzọ mgbe e mesịrị — a na-akwado mpaghara ya mgbe e kere ya.

migration.title: Bufee faịlụ ndị ị nwere ugbua
migration.intro: Ịhọrọ onye na-eweta ọrụ na-agbanwe naanị ebe nbugo ọhụrụ ga-aga. Ihe niile ebugoro na mbụ na-anọgide ebe ọ dị ma na-adọta ruo mgbe ị bufere ya.
migration.step1: Hazie onye na-eweta ọrụ n'elu ma pịa Nwalee njikọ — mbufe na-ebugo n'ime ihe echekwara ebe a.
migration.step2: Bufee ozi nzere echekwara gaa n'usoro nke onye na-eweta ọrụ ọ bụla. Ọ dị mma na ụdị ọ bụla, ọ dịghịkwa eme ihe ọ bụla ozugbo ọ gbara otu ugboro.
migration.step3: Bugoo faịlụ ndị dị na sava ma degharịa URL ha n'ime ọdụ data niile. Ọsọ nnwale na-edepụta faịlụ ọ bụla ma ọ naghị ede ihe ọ bụla.
migration.step4: Lelee ụlọ ahịa na Ọba Mgbasa Ozi. A naghị ehichapụ ihe ọ bụla na diski, ya mere wepụ ndetu mpaghara n'aka gị ozugbo foto malitere ịpụta.
migration.backup: Tupu mbugharị ọzọ: ọ bụrụ na usoro mmelite gị na-edochi nchekwa ngwa — nbugo cPanel, ide zip n'elu, kontena na-enweghị volume — buru ụzọ detuo media si na sava. Idochi nchekwa ahụ na-ehichapụ ha.
migration.note: Faịlụ nke dara ịbugo na-ejigide URL mpaghara ya, ya mere ọsọ na-ezughị ezu na-ahapụ ụlọ ahịa na-arụ ọrụ karịa nke gbajiri ọkara. Ịgba ọzọ dị mma.

help.cloudfront: CloudFront ma ọ bụ ngalaba nke gị maka inye faịlụ ebulitere
help.privateBucket: A na-edebe akwụkwọ njirimara, ngwaahịa dijitalụ na akwụkwọ nnata mmefu ebe a, ọ bụkwa naanị njikọ e binyere aka na-emepe ha. Mepụta ya n'otu akaụntụ ahụ, ohere ọha agbanyụrụ na-enweghị ngalaba ejikọrọ; igodo ndị dị n'elu ga-enwerịrị ikike iji ya.
help.r2Domain: Subdomain R2.dev nke bọket gị ma ọ bụ ngalaba nke gị ejikọrọ — achọrọ ya iji nye faịlụ ebulitere n'ihu ọha
help.r2FindOverview: Chọta nke a na Cloudflare Dashboard → R2 → Overview

storage.privateBucketMissing: Enweghị bọket nzuzo: a na-edebe akwụkwọ njirimara, ngwaahịa dijitalụ na akwụkwọ nnata mmefu na bọket ọha dị n'elu, ebe onye ọ bụla nwere adreesị faịlụ nwere ike imepe ya. Tinye bọket nzuzo, wee gbaa pnpm db:migrate private-storage iji bufee faịlụ echekwalarị.
storage.r2PublicUrlMissing: Na-enweghị URL ọha, a gaghị egosi faịlụ ebulitere n'ụlọ ahịa gị — URL onyonyo na vidiyo ga-atụ aka na endpoint R2 nzuzo ma ghara ibudata. Na Cloudflare Dashboard → R2 → bọket gị → Settings → Public access, gbanye subdomain R2.dev (ma ọ bụ jikọọ ngalaba nke gị) ma tinye URL ahụ ebe a.

guide.title: Ntuziaka nhazi Commerce Manager
guide.step1: Mepee Meta Commerce Manager ma họrọ katalọgụ gị, ma ọ bụ mepụta katalọgụ azụmahịa ịntanetị.
guide.step2: Gaa na Catalog → Data sources → Add items, họrọ Data feed, wee pịa Next.
guide.step3: Họrọ Scheduled feed ma mado URL feed dị n'elu.
guide.step4: Hazie ya ka ọ na-emeghachi Hourly, họrọ {currency} dị ka ego, wee pịa Upload.
guide.step5: Na Events Manager, jikọọ katalọgụ ahụ na Meta Pixel ị tinyere na Settings → Analytics, ka mgbasa ozi nwee ike ijikọ nlele na ịzụrụ ihe na ngwaahịa.
guide.step6: Mgbe iweta mbụ gasịrị, Catalog → Issues na-edepụta ngwaahịa ọ bụla Meta jụrụ.
guide.caution: Mgbe ị mepụtachara URL ọhụrụ, gbanwee URL nke isi data dị adị. Isi data nke abụọ ga-edepụta ngwaahịa ọ bụla ugboro abụọ.

guide.title: Ntuziaka nhazi ndakọrịta ozugbo
guide.step1: Na Meta Business Manager, mepee Business settings → Users → System users, ma tinye system user nwere ọrụ Admin.
guide.step2: Pịa Assign assets, họrọ Catalogs, họrọ katalọgụ gị ma gbanye Manage catalog.
guide.step3: Pịa Generate new token, họrọ ngwa gị, hazie ya ka oge ya ghara ịgwụ ma kaa ikike a akara. Detuo token ahụ:
guide.step4: Na Commerce Manager, mepee katalọgụ ahụ ma detuo ID ya, nọmba dị n'okpuru aha ya.
guide.step5: Mado ha abụọ n'elu ma pịa Chekwaa. Ndakọrịta mbụ na-eziga ngwaahịa ọ bụla; mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, naanị ihe gbanwere ka a na-eziga, n'ime ihe dị ka nkeji atọ.
guide.step6: Ọ bụrụ na katalọgụ a nwere isi data feed a haziri oge ya, hichapụ ya na Catalog → Data sources, ka ọ bụrụ naanị otu isi data na-ede ngwaahịa.
guide.caution: Lekọta token ahụ dị ka paswọọdụ. Ọ bụrụ na a kagbuo ya ma ọ bụ oge ya agwụ, ndakọrịta ozugbo na-akwụsịtụ, a na-agwakwa ndị nchịkwa.
guide.off: Ịgbanyụ ndakọrịta ozugbo na-ahapụ ngwaahịa nọbu na Meta otú ha dị. Wepụ ha na Commerce Manager ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọghịzi ha.
